rule: Thrift+ credit (refund money) is always used first, automatically, up to the whole total, as a payment after tax. Rewards apply only to what is left: first any saved Rewards the member chooses to use (soonest use-by date first), then today's rewards at 80%. Because rewards come off before tax, the register works out the rewards so that the Thrift+ credit is spent in full first. If the Thrift+ credit covers the whole total, no rewards are used that trip: today's rewards are saved in full and saved Rewards stay saved. Rewards can't pay for consignment items; Thrift+ credit can. Items bought with credit or Rewards still earn rewards.
title: Spending: Thrift+ credit always first
words: Thrift+ credit is always used first.
